attributes.name: Thought Shield
attributes.powers: Discard this card to reduce all damage dealt to a character at your location by your Intelligence or Perception modifier, then you may reset your hand. You may play this spell even if you played another spell on this check.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 or Perception 10 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
